blurb: Locurio provides immersive escape room adventures and puzzle hunts in the Fremont neighborhood of Seattle. Their experiences include indoor escape rooms with narrative-driven puzzles and an outdoor puzzle hunt around the neighborhood. They also offer a mobile team-building puzzle event for larger groups.
extraNote: All sales are final; no refunds for cancellations or no-shows · Cancellations accepted up to 24 hours in advance for outdoor puzzle hunt · Private booking model; no strangers joined · Additional players allowed up to two over max with prior notice and payment · Travel fee of $250 for The Falswift Objective outside Seattle area · Alley behind the Fremont Annex building, accessible from Evanston Ave or Fremont Ave N, enter Suite 102 via the alley
